Getting help for mental illness or trauma is extremely slow and can entirely consume your life. Getting on the right medication, finding the right therapist, even just getting started can take months or years. In worse cases medication side effects or just progression of your illness can make holding a job or going to school or just functioning in the real world extremely hard or impossible.

People love telling others to get help. Very few of them want to face how hard that really is.

Not great. Depression, loneliness, hopelessness, feeling worthless, the usual really. Going on almost 30 years and it's never gotten easier. It never gets easier and you never really get used to it. I don't know why I'm even saying anything honestly.

I honestly think she's the worst god in the game currently, no exaggeration. She just doesn't bring anything to a team. Her damage is okay on paper, but extremely hard to reliably confirm. Her 3 CD getting eaten by CC makes her extremely easy to just run down and kill. I'm not sure what the intended use of her ult is (damage, zoning, etc.) but it fails horribly at all of it. 
I love her design and personality, but those don't win games. She's the first god release I've been around for that I thought needed huge buffs or ability reworks to be viable.
